items.name: ExtractKind
items.summary: The kind of literals to extract from an [`Hir`] expression.

methods.name: is_prefix
methods.summary: Returns true if this kind is the `Prefix` variant.

methods.name: is_suffix
methods.summary: Returns true if this kind is the `Suffix` variant.

items.name: rank
items.summary: Returns the "rank" of the given byte.

items.name: Extractor
items.summary: Extracts prefix or suffix literal sequences from [`Hir`] expressions.

methods.name: extract
methods.summary: Execute the extractor and return a sequence of literals.

methods.name: kind
methods.signature: fn kind(&mut self, kind: ExtractKind) -> &mut Extractor
methods.summary: Set the kind of literal sequence to extract from an [`Hir`] expression.

methods.name: limit_class
methods.signature: fn limit_class(&mut self, limit: usize) -> &mut Extractor
methods.summary: Configure a limit on the length of the sequence that is permitted for a character class. If a character class exceeds this limit, then the sequence returned for it is infinite.

methods.name: limit_literal_len
methods.signature: fn limit_literal_len(&mut self, limit: usize) -> &mut Extractor
methods.summary: Configure a limit on the maximum length of any literal in a sequence.

methods.name: limit_repeat
methods.signature: fn limit_repeat(&mut self, limit: usize) -> &mut Extractor
methods.summary: Configure a limit on the total number of repetitions that is permitted before literal extraction is stopped.

methods.name: limit_total
methods.signature: fn limit_total(&mut self, limit: usize) -> &mut Extractor
methods.summary: Configure a limit on the total number of literals that will be returned.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new extractor with a default configuration.

items.name: Literal
items.summary: A single literal extracted from an [`Hir`] expression.

methods.name: as_bytes
methods.summary: Returns the bytes in this literal.

methods.name: exact
methods.summary: Returns a new exact literal containing the bytes given.

methods.name: extend
methods.summary: Extend this literal with the literal given.

methods.name: inexact
methods.summary: Returns a new inexact literal containing the bytes given.

methods.name: into_bytes
methods.summary: Yields ownership of the bytes inside this literal.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this literal has zero bytes.

methods.name: is_exact
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this literal is exact.

methods.name: keep_first_bytes
methods.summary: Trims this literal such that only the first `len` bytes remain. If this literal has fewer than `len` bytes, then it remains unchanged. Otherwise, the literal is marked as inexact.

methods.name: keep_last_bytes
methods.summary: Trims this literal such that only the last `len` bytes remain. If this literal has fewer than `len` bytes, then it remains unchanged. Otherwise, the literal is marked as inexact.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the length of this literal in bytes.

methods.name: make_inexact
methods.summary: Marks this literal as inexact.

methods.name: reverse
methods.summary: Reverse the bytes in this literal.

methods.name: cross_forward
methods.summary: Modify this sequence to contain the cross product between it and the sequence given.

methods.name: cross_reverse
methods.summary: Modify this sequence to contain the cross product between it and the sequence given, where the sequences are treated as suffixes instead of prefixes. Namely, the sequence `other` is *prepended* to `self` (as opposed to `other` being *appen…

methods.name: dedup
methods.summary: Deduplicate adjacent equivalent literals in this sequence.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Returns an empty sequence.

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<T: IntoIterator<Item = Literal>>(it: T) -> Seq

methods.name: infinite
methods.summary: Returns a sequence of literals without a finite size and may contain any literal.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this sequence is finite and empty.

methods.name: is_exact
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if all literals in this sequence are exact.

methods.name: is_finite
methods.summary: Returns true if this sequence is finite.

methods.name: is_inexact
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if all literals in this sequence are inexact.

methods.name: keep_first_bytes
methods.summary: Trims all literals in this seq such that only the first `len` bytes remain. If a literal has less than or equal to `len` bytes, then it remains unchanged. Otherwise, it is trimmed and made inexact.

methods.name: keep_last_bytes
methods.summary: Trims all literals in this seq such that only the last `len` bytes remain. If a literal has less than or equal to `len` bytes, then it remains unchanged. Otherwise, it is trimmed and made inexact.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of literals in this sequence if the sequence is finite. If the sequence is infinite, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: literals
methods.summary: If this is a finite sequence, return its members as a slice of literals.

methods.name: longest_common_prefix
methods.summary: Returns the longest common prefix from this seq.

methods.name: longest_common_suffix
methods.summary: Returns the longest common suffix from this seq.

methods.name: make_inexact
methods.summary: Make all of the literals in this sequence inexact.

methods.name: make_infinite
methods.summary: Converts this sequence to an infinite sequence.

methods.name: max_cross_len
methods.summary: Return the maximum length of the sequence that would result from the cross product of `self` with `other`. If either set is infinite, then this returns `None`.

methods.name: max_literal_len
methods.summary: Returns the length of the longest literal in this sequence.

methods.name: max_union_len
methods.summary: Return the maximum length of the sequence that would result from unioning `self` with `other`. If either set is infinite, then this returns `None`.

methods.name: min_literal_len
methods.summary: Returns the length of the shortest literal in this sequence.

methods.name: minimize_by_preference
methods.summary: Shrinks this seq to its minimal size while respecting the preference order of its literals.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<I, B>(it: I) -> Seq where I: IntoIterator<Item = B>, B: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Returns a sequence of exact literals from the given byte strings.

methods.name: optimize_for_prefix_by_preference
methods.summary: Optimizes this seq while treating its literals as prefixes and respecting the preference order of its literals.

methods.name: optimize_for_suffix_by_preference
methods.summary: Optimizes this seq while treating its literals as suffixes and respecting the preference order of its literals.

methods.name: push
methods.summary: Push a literal to the end of this sequence.

methods.name: reverse_literals
methods.summary: Reverses all of the literals in this sequence.

methods.name: singleton
methods.summary: Returns a sequence containing a single literal.

methods.name: sort
methods.summary: Sorts this sequence of literals lexicographically.

methods.name: union
methods.summary: Unions the `other` sequence into this one.

methods.name: union_into_empty
methods.summary: Unions the `other` sequence into this one by splice the `other` sequence at the position of the first zero-length literal.
